purpose.en: Practice trunk control while moving opposite limbs.

text.zh: 下背紧贴地面，对侧手脚慢慢伸远
text.en: Keep your lower back on the floor and slowly extend the opposite arm and leg

text.zh: 回程缓慢，回到起始位再换另一组手脚
text.en: Return slowly to the starting position before alternating limbs.

text.zh: 保持呼吸，动作幅度以腰背稳定为限
text.en: Keep breathing and limit your reach to the range you can control.

commonErrors.zh: 伸手伸腿时腰背明显拱起
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back as the limbs extend.
Swinging the limbs instead of controlling the movement.

cautions.zh: 腰背：伸远手脚时保持躯干可控；一旦腰背明显拱起，缩小活动幅度。
cautions.en: Lower back: shorten the limb reach if you cannot keep your trunk controlled.

cautions.zh: 髋前侧：伸腿范围以舒适、可控为限，不用憋气维持姿势。
cautions.en: Front of the hip: keep the leg range comfortable and controlled, and keep breathing.
